Dear University of South Alabama community, as we face the hurricane season in Alabama, [Your office] invites the University of South Alabama to share official preparedness messages with your local audience in Mobile County and Baldwin County.

"Know your evacuation zone and route now. Build a kit with water, food, medicine and important documents, and follow evacuation orders from local officials."

Thank you for helping keep our university and local communities safe. Sincerely, [Your name], [Your office].

invitations.subject: Partnering for Tornado Safety in Oklahoma
invitations.body:
Dear Oklahoma City Blue, as a team with a strong local connection in Oklahoma, your voice matters greatly in our community. Since severe weather is a concern in Oklahoma County and Cleveland County, we are asking you to help us share official preparedness messages with your fans this season.

"Know your safe place before a warning: a basement, or a small interior room on the lowest floor away from windows. Have more than one way to receive warnings, and act immediately when a Tornado Warning is issued."
(Source: National Weather Service, https://www.weather.gov/safety/tornado)

Thank you for supporting safety in our community. Sincerely, [Your name], [Your office].

invitations.subject: Partnering to Keep Tulsa County Safe This Tornado Season
invitations.body:
Dear FC Tulsa team, as emergency managers serving Tulsa County, Oklahoma, we invite you to help protect our local community this tornado season by sharing official preparedness messages with your fans.

"Know your safe place before a warning: a basement, or a small interior room on the lowest floor away from windows. Have more than one way to receive warnings, and act immediately when a Tornado Warning is issued."
(Source: National Weather Service, https://www.weather.gov/safety/tornado)

Thank you for your partnership in keeping Oklahoma safe. Sincerely, [Your name], [Your office].
